title: Spring4Shell RCE (CVE-2022-22965)
description: Your project is vulnerable to Spring4Shell, CVE-2022-22965. The Spring Framework allows remote code execution through data binding when running on JDK 9 or later. An attacker can craft a malicious request to write a web shell. Upgrade Spring to 5.3.18 or later immediately.
poc_text: class.module.classLoader data-binding payload to drop a JSP web shell.
